cd /workspace/task/scratch; python3 - <<'EOF'
import re
t=open('report.md',encoding='utf-8').read()
lines=t.split('\n')
out=[];inside=False
for ln in lines:
    if re.match(r'^##\s',ln):
        if inside: break
        if ln.strip()=='## 风险': inside=True; continue
    if inside: out.append(ln)
res='\n'.join(out).strip()
open('risk.txt','w',encoding='utf-8').write(res+'\n')
print(repr(res))
EOF
echo "=== risk.txt"; cat risk.txt; echo "=== md5 after"; md5sum report.md
arguments.label: Extract risk section
